extraction.pages_processed: 3-23 (whole report read against a keyword screen of the whole text; passages found read in full); pages 1-2 are the Council cover note and cover page
extraction.notes: RUN-2026-02 stage 7. Keywords screened over the whole text: digit*, electronic, e-gov*, online, internet, broadband, cyber*, artificial intelligence, AI, data protection, personal data, interoperab*, MConnect, MPass, MSign, e-service, signature, trust service, identification, 5G, telecom*, information society, portal, ICT, IT system, information system, database, open data, platform, technolog*, workers, labour market, EURES, social security, EHIC, health insurance card, work permit, foreign*, migra*, free movement, freedom of movement, Chapter 2, European Labour Authority, EESSI. Joint staff working document of the Commission services and the EEAS; speaker recorded as printed on the cover, with no actor record. Period covered from page 3 (since the last report of 13 October 2021). The Association Agreement does not cover Chapter 2, and the report has no passage on the rights of EU or foreign workers, EURES or social security coordination, so there are no chapter items; the informal employment, minimum wage and pension passages (pages 15-16) are general labour and social policy, outside the Chapter 2 boundary. Left out under the materiality test: the Budapest Convention protocol and cybercrime (pages 12-13, R21), the Security and Intelligence Service blocking websites and online disinformation (pages 6-7), European Peace Facility support for cyber defence and tactical communications of the armed forces (pages 8, 21-22), the security and defence consultations listing cyber security among topics (page 8), the lack of IT resources at the National Bureau of Statistics (page 15), digital skills training for teachers (page 20, not linked to an in-scope recommendation) and the Economic and Investment Plan's general reference to the digital transition (page 21). The telecommunications item on page 8 concerns the Transnistrian settlement process (LIM-0044). Doubtful cases are flagged theme_doubtful.
